asin.description: Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN), multiple ASINs separated by English commas, up to 5, with a maximum length of 300 characters. Example: `B0088PUEPK` or `B0088PUEPK,B00U26V4VQ,B07M68S376`

history.description: Whether the return value contains historical data and historical sales; `1` = contains time series data such as price history, sales ranking, historical sales, etc. `0` = only returns basic product information.
